field_notes.generated_at: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp with timezone offset; indicates when the response was generated.
field_notes.timestamp: Hour-start timestamp of the electricity observation. Currently timezone-naive; production timezone semantics must be agreed with Developers A and C.
field_notes.consumption_kwh: Observed electricity consumption in kWh. Incomplete observations are not returned as anomalies.
field_notes.anomaly_score: Number from 0 to 1, calibrated against the model's training score distribution. Higher means more unusual. It is not the probability of a real anomaly.
field_notes.severity: Stable UI-facing category: low, medium, or high. The dashboard should use this field for alert styling rather than applying its own score thresholds.

local_baseline.calibration: Empirical percentile of training absolute robust z-scores
local_baseline.note: Thresholds describe the current local baseline. Future models should preserve the response contract and document their calibration.
